stem: A ball is thrown vertically up with a certain velocity from the top of a tower of height 40 m. At 4.5 m above the top of the tower its speed is exactly half of that it will have at 4.5 m below the top of the tower. Find the maximum height reached by the ball above the ground?

assets.alt: A ball thrown up from the top of a 40 m tower. At 4.5 m above the top its speed is v, and at 4.5 m below the top it is 2v; H′ is the height it rises above the top.
